subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: I can understand the story Atomic is colourful!
I can say True or False about the story.
I can see beauty in nature, art and music.

tf.why: Yes! Mix blue and yellow and you get green.

tf.s: Sami and Jack play tennis in the park before school.
tf.why: Well done! They play in the park before school.

tf.s: Jack and Sami have tennis lessons at school.
tf.why: They say We don't have tennis lessons.

tf.s: The children have art lessons at school today.
tf.why: Yes! They have art lessons today.
They have art lessons at school today.

tf.s: Atomic is colourful at the end of the story.
tf.why: Atomic gets paint on him, so he is colourful.

tf.s: Polly gets paint on her and becomes colourful.
tf.why: Atomic is the colourful one in the story.

tf.s: At the end, the children paint a picture of Atomic.
Listening to music together can be seeing beauty.
tf.why: We can see beauty in music too.

tf.s: We can only see beauty in art, not in nature.
tf.why: We can see beauty in everything: nature, art and music.

mcq.q: What does What a mess! mean?
mcq.why: We say What a mess! when things are not tidy.

mcq.q: You have blue paint and yellow paint. What colour can you make?
Choose: We have / don't have art lessons at school today.
o: We have art lessons at school today.
We don't have art lessons at school today.

We not have art lessons today.
mcq.why: In the story they have art lessons today.

o: A cat sleeps on a book.

o: They tidy up and paint Atomic.

mcq.q: Which shows the value See beauty in everything?
o: You enjoy the colours of the flowers.
You say the flowers are ugly.
You close your eyes in art class.
You do not listen to music.
mcq.why: Enjoying nature's colours is seeing beauty.
